packageRules.description: Batch 1: every non-breaking update (minor, patch, digest, pin) in one PR. Gated deps keep their own rules below.
Batch 2: breaking updates in one PR, reviewed on their own. Majors, plus 0.x minor bumps, which Cargo treats as breaking.
Batch 3: Rust toolchain alone, so a compiler change never hides inside a dependency failure.
Batch 4: crypto and TLS crates alone, whatever the update type, so their API changes get dedicated review.
Frozen inputs, not dependencies: upstream workflow fixtures pin old versions on purpose, and benchmarks pin images and crates so past results stay comparable.
SmolVM bumps auto-merge once ci.yml and the smolvm-release-verify check pass (the verify job runs the real-VM E2E on GitHub-hosted KVM).
Runner bump PR is the tripwire for the runner-watch pipeline (diff -> triage -> record-golden -> conform -> tiered PRs). Never auto-merge: the protocol delta needs the pipeline's goldens and review.
Node externals bumps track nodejs.org dist; gated by supply-chain.yml OSV/SBOM checks. Never auto-merge — the supply-chain workflow must pass first.

customManagers.description: Official actions/runner release pin in versions.toml. The bump PR is the tripwire: it is labeled protocol-sync, and .github/workflows/runner-sync.yml runs watch-pipeline stages on it and opens the tiered PRs (docs/conformance.md). It must never auto-merge.

SmolVM release the golden workflow builds with. The bump PR is gated by .github/workflows/smolvm-release-verify.yml, which installs the candidate and runs the real-VM E2E on GitHub-hosted KVM; green runs auto-merge.

Node 20 externals pin in versions.toml. Tracks nodejs.org dist (node-version datasource) for the Node.js bundled with the runner externals; bumps are gated by supply-chain.yml (OSV + SBOM) and must not auto-merge.

Node 24 externals pin in versions.toml. Tracks nodejs.org dist (node-version datasource) for the Node.js bundled with the runner externals; bumps are gated by supply-chain.yml (OSV + SBOM) and must not auto-merge.
